definition: רָזָה verb be or grow lean (Arabic grow thin and weak ); — Qal Perfect 3 masculine singular רָזָה Zeph 2:11 object false gods, apparently make lean ( ᵑ9 attenuavit ; ᵐ5 is ἐξολεθρύσει ), but sense strange, < רִזָּה (see Arabic above), yet even this very doubtful. Niph`al be made lean, Imperfect 3 masculine singular מִשְׁמַן בְּשָׂרוֺ יֵרָזֶה Isa 17:4 .
